integrity: The proof is elementary and addresses all parameters on a closed probability cube; exact rational enumeration is supplemental, not an infinite-domain certificate. The originality finding is based on specified prior sources and literature searches, not an independence claim.
limitations: The exact constant is proved only for two Bernoulli coordinates, not three or more or arbitrary alphabets. The displayed mass-sensitive bound is not claimed pointwise sharp. The asymptotic optimality example is from the prior work; independent priority beyond inspected sources cannot be guaranteed.
title: Sharp two-coordinate Bernoulli total-variation homogenization
